constraint.title: Data Validation Rules
constraint.description: All test customer records must conform to API validation rules defined in Story 2.1 (Customer Domain Model): firstName/lastName required and 1-100 chars, email required and valid format, phone optional but must match pattern if provided, dateOfBirth optional but must be age 18+, zipCode optional but 5-6 digits.

constraint.title: Idempotent Script Requirement
constraint.description: SQL seed script must be safe to run multiple times without causing errors or duplicate data. Use UPSERT syntax or DELETE-before-INSERT pattern to ensure idempotency.

constraint.title: Flyway Migration Convention
constraint.description: Migration script must follow Flyway naming convention: V{number}__{description}.sql (e.g., V3__seed_test_customers.sql). Place in base/src/main/resources/db/migration/ directory.

constraint.title: Test Data Status
constraint.description: All test customers must be created with status = ACTIVE to enable testing of active customer scenarios. Inactive customer testing is separate.

constraint.title: No Production Data
constraint.description: Test data must use example.com email domain and clearly identifiable test names/IDs. Ensure test data never gets promoted to production environment.

interface.name: Flyway Database Migration
interface.description: Framework for managing database schema changes and data seeding. Automatically executes migration scripts on application startup.

tests.standards: Test data seeding should follow integration testing standards: test data created at database layer via migration scripts, not through API calls (to avoid dependency on Story 2.2). Manual UI testing will verify data appears and is searchable. Data reset for test isolation should use transaction rollback or separate test database. SQL migration scripts should be validated to run without errors on both fresh and existing databases.
